status_definitions.VALIDATED_WITHIN_DOMAIN: Requires qualified reference/optical assay, supported uncertainty and independent external validation; no v4 sample assigned.
status_definitions.EXPLORATORY: An in-domain model-conditional estimate under retrospectively corrected S7 metadata; not validated RNA or AC accuracy.
status_definitions.NONIDENTIFIABLE: Exact plateau has an interval inverse; no arbitrary point.
status_definitions.OUT_OF_CALIBRATION_RANGE: Response outside fitted range; unavailable, not clipped or extrapolated.
